scenario: A product and engineering leader at a small, rapidly growing creative-technology company shares Jamie's Team Memory page with company decision-makers. The team is losing product rationale, decisions, open questions, and onboarding context across meetings and working documents. The sponsor believes Jamie may be able to lead a focused, paid discovery and prototype engagement that improves how the team thinks and executes without imposing a heavy parallel bureaucracy.
acceptanceQuestion: Based only on the anonymized sponsor perspective, anonymized sponsor voice profile, and the rendered public site beginning at the Team Memory page, would the fictionalized sponsor and company decision-makers hire Jamie now for the focused paid engagement their needs support?
requiredTeamMemorySignals: A two-week discovery and prototype sprint the team can authorize
One sponsor, one working lead, and two or three teammates
Three to five approved sources around one decision trail
A knowledge-friction map, start-here page, decision record, open-question list
The team decides to continue, revise, or stop
continuing maintenance without a separate agreement

transmissionPolicy.interpretation: Equivalent evaluations may reuse this public-safe packet pattern. Authorization does not extend to raw source material, protected identities, private archives, unrelated records, credentials, or private locators.

modelGate.humanMeaning: A pass is an uncalibrated fictionalized model simulation that the public proposal is clear enough to support a focused paid engagement. It is not Jonathan Marmor's view, his employer's view, an endorsement, budget authorization, an offer, a contract, or a promise of work.
